connectivity_tips.tip: eSIM is recommended for most convenient connectivity. Activate instantly before departure or upon arrival. No physical SIM swapping required. Reliable 4G/5G coverage across Seoul & Busan. Cost: ~INR 1,200–2,500 for 7–10 days (data-only plans).
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/25052026_Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Physical Tourist SIM Cards are available at Incheon Airport (Seoul) and Gimhae Airport (Busan). Data-only or data + local call options. Passport required for purchase. Cost: ~INR 1,500–3,000 depending on duration.
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/25052026_Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Pocket WiFi is available for multiple devices (3–5 devices). Must carry and charge the device daily. Pick-up and return at airport counters. Cost: ~INR 800–1,200 per day.
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/25052026_Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Excellent mobile coverage in Seoul, Busan, subways, and tourist areas. Strong signal even underground in metro stations. Free WiFi available in cafés, malls, and hotels — but having personal data is highly recommended for navigation.
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/25052026_Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: South Korea uses Type C & Type F plugs. Voltage: 220V. Carry a universal adapter.
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Recommended navigation apps: Naver Map (best for directions and public transport), KakaoMap (excellent for local navigation and real-time directions), and Subway Korea App (helpful for subway routes and transfers). Note: Google Maps is limited in Korea.
connectivity_tips._source_file: South Korea/Farha_South Korea_ All Inclusive Guide.docx
